# Draft:Kingofshrinivash

----
----
Shrinivash Vanzara (also known as Kingofshrinivash) is an Indian businessman, real estate developer, and political figure based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. He is the founder of a real estate company operating in the Bhadaj area and is affiliated with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). In April 2025, he was elected as a corporator representing the Bhadaj ward.
Early Life and Family
Shrinivash Vanzara was born in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. He is the son of Bhai Lakhisah Banjara, a notable figure in the Banjara community. Growing up in a business-oriented family, he became involved in real estate from a young age.
Business Career
Vanzara owns and manages a real estate firm that operates primarily in Bhadaj and nearby areas. Under his leadership, the company has undertaken several residential and commercial projects. His work in this sector has made him a known figure among young entrepreneurs in Ahmedabad.
Political Career
In 2025, Shrinivash Vanzara joined the Bharatiya Janata Party and successfully contested the Ahmedabad Municipal Elections, becoming the corporator for Bhadaj. He is seen as a rising political leader and a role model for youth in the region.
Legal Controversies
Shrinivash Vanzara has been associated with more than four legal cases. However, detailed public documentation about these cases is limited. Despite this, his popularity among local youth has remained strong.
Personal Life
Shrinivash Vanzara maintains a strong connection with his community and credits his father, Bhai Lakhisah Banjara, as a key influence in his life.
